claims.claim: A destination collision inside the legacy session batch aborted the whole loop instead of skipping the colliding file, stranding every later legacy session in the agent root.

The repaired collision branch skips only the colliding file (both the legacy copy and the pre-existing destination copy are preserved), so the remaining batch continues and repeated runs stay idempotent.
Files with malformed headers are still left untouched and do not interrupt the batch.

validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the destination-collision branch used `return`, which exited the whole per-file loop after the first colliding legacy session; it now uses `continue`, skipping only that file, keeping both the legacy copy and the pre-existing destination copy, and letting the rest of the batch migrate. Regression runs with node v24.14.0: it loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createGraph() with an in-memory fs boundary (existsSync/mkdirSync/readdirSync/readFileSync/writeFileSync/renameSync/rmSync) plus boundary bindings for getAgentDir/getBinDir/CONFIG_DIR_NAME/migrateKeybindingsConfig/stripBom/chalk default, so no real files, no network, and no dependencies are touched. Seeded batch order is deterministic: (1) a legacy file whose destination already holds a different session file, (2) a file with a malformed JSON header, (3) a healthy legacy file that must still migrate. Assertions: the later healthy session must leave the agent root and its destination content must match byte-for-byte; the colliding legacy source and the pre-existing destination copy must both be preserved unchanged; the malformed header file must not be migrated and must remain byte-identical; the agent root must contain only the colliding and malformed files plus the sessions directory; a second run must be idempotent (deep-equal filesystem snapshot, no throw, no double migration). Verified the regression detects the original fault: temporarily restoring `if (existsSync(newPath)) return;` makes the script exit 1 with AssertionError 'a collision earlier in the batch must not strand later legacy sessions in the agent root'; with the repair it exits 0. Type stripping via the VM loader confirms the edited source parses. Optional validation dependencies unavailable (no node_modules installed, so vitest, tsc/tsgo and biome could not be run; scripts/check-ts-relative-imports.mjs fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for 'typescript'); no dependencies were installed.
